ov: Forty-four species of rainforest birds, mainly from New Guinea, plus eastern Australia and the Maluku Islands. Males of most species have spectacular plumes and colours, and some perform highly ritualised mating dances.
len: 15 cm to 110 cm with tail (black sicklebill)
rg: Mainly New Guinea, plus eastern Australia and the Maluku Islands.
df: Mostly fruit, plus some insects and other arthropods.
fx: A plume from the greater bird-of-paradise decorated the royal crown of Nepal.
Some species can absorb light and re-emit it at wavelengths visible to other birds.
